profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
Software Engineer: I work as a software engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co. My current team develops a tool to harvest, normalize, and display firmwide metadata in ServiceNow. My primary focuses are data engineering and backend development. We are working to deploy our harvester application, written in Python, to AWS, using Terraform to build our AWS framework.

I also worked on another software development team at JPMorgan Chase. My team built, maintained, and improved an application that transformed raw data into PDF reports. I worked extensively on our companion application for regression testing as well as the backend of the application itself. I added new features to existing report pages, and I upgraded the application to include additional RESTful endpoints. Both applications used Java Spring frameworks.

Information Security Specialist: For my graduate degree, I studied information assurance at the University of Texas at Dallas. I also worked in Experian's Global Security Office as a summer intern where I was part of the governance and controls team. I verified regulatory compliance and also researched controls to help the team prepare for control tests. In my current roles, I utilize my knowledge to practice secure coding.

Programming Languages: Java, Python, Bash, C, C++, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Groovy, SQL
